fusion_protocol: Transcript evidence + Stage-A visual observations → ProductionEvent(s)

production_events.transcript_claim: Deactivate shaper box, activate serum, load initial preset
production_events.visual_observation: Serum 2 UI fully loaded at frame_002 with default preset visible, initialization complete
production_events.fusion_result: AGREEMENT: Serum initialization visually confirmed; preset ready for configuration

production_events.transcript_claim: Select mono, go into default shapes, select saw minus one unison, activate phase distortion from B
production_events.visual_observation: Frame_003: Saw waveform selected in OSC A (green diagonal lines). Frame_004: Phase distortion menu open showing route/sync options (PD route visible)
production_events.fusion_result: AGREEMENT: Saw waveform and phase distortion setup visually confirmed through UI controls

production_events.transcript_claim: Activate oscillator B with default waves default shape saw plus one, level all the way down to zero
production_events.visual_observation: Frame_005: OSC B highlighted in menu with routing options. Frame_006: Saw waveform for OSC B visible, level slider at minimum (zero)
production_events.fusion_result: AGREEMENT: OSC B saw wave and zero level setting confirmed visually

production_events.transcript_claim: Select free chaos Lorentz in the LFO, select the X (axis), put it to the fine as 10
production_events.visual_observation: Frame_007: Chaos Lorentz waveform label visible, chaotic oscilloscope pattern displayed. Frame_008: LFO chaos elliptical spiral pattern confirmed in visualization
production_events.fusion_result: AGREEMENT: LFO chaos (Lorentz attractor) waveform type confirmed; fine parameter adjustment visible

production_events.transcript_claim: Select a free chaos Lorentz in the LFO, select a noise white filter up level all the way down to zero, modulate this with envelope 3
production_events.visual_observation: Frame_009: Noise oscillator visible with level at minimum, Envelope 1 tab showing ADSR visualization. Frame_010: Envelope 3 tab active with ADSR controls configured
production_events.fusion_result: AGREEMENT: Noise oscillator at zero level and Envelope 3 setup confirmed; modulation routing ready

production_events.transcript_claim: Filter MG18, only A (oscillator A only, not B), select this is going to be only A, modulate this with envelope 2
production_events.visual_observation: Frame_011: Filter section expanded with MG18 option context, Oscillator A routing prominent, B appears dimmed. Frame_012: Filter routing confirmed with Envelope 2 path indicator visible
production_events.fusion_result: AGREEMENT: Filter MG18 type and oscillator A-only routing confirmed; Envelope 2 modulation connection established

production_events.transcript_claim: Envelope 2, modulate this with envelope 2, envelope 2 is going to go 100%, more resonance
production_events.visual_observation: Frame_013: ENV 2 tab active showing ADSR with waveform visualization; 100% modulation response visible in resonance/cutoff area. Frame_014: Envelope 2 ADSR refined with sustain lowered, decay reduced, release increased
production_events.fusion_result: AGREEMENT: Envelope 2 at 100% modulation depth confirmed; pluck effect ADSR parameters visually set

production_events.transcript_claim: Envelope 4, sustain all the way down, decay pretty much all the way down, intensify the pluck with this, main tuning in the global
production_events.visual_observation: Frame_015: ENV 4 tab active, ADSR controls showing sustain and decay at minimum, global tuning modulation area visible with pluck intensification parameter
production_events.fusion_result: AGREEMENT: Envelope 4 pluck intensification setup confirmed; global tuning modulation path established

production_events.transcript_claim: Sending a bit of filter one to bus number one, bus number one is going directly out, convolve and select a long digital hall number two
production_events.visual_observation: Frame_016: Effects panel showing Bus 1 routing structure, Convolver effect (Digital Hall 2 reverb impulse) visible in chain, signal flow routing diagram present
production_events.fusion_result: AGREEMENT: Filter-to-Bus1 routing and Convolver reverb (Digital Hall 2) setup confirmed

production_events.transcript_claim: Start by using a distortion overdrive, more drive which is going to turn the loudness a lot up, a bit less mix
production_events.visual_observation: Frame_017: Distortion effect in main chain, Overdrive label/control visible, drive parameter increased (visual loudness response indicator present), mix/balance slider visible
production_events.fusion_result: AGREEMENT: Distortion overdrive effect with increased drive and mix adjustment confirmed

production_events.transcript_claim: Now hyper just to make things a bit wider, rate all the way down, mix a little bit down, seven voices, a bit of the tune as well, size down and the dimension a bit up
production_events.visual_observation: Frame_018: Hyper/Dimension effect prominent, voice count parameter visible (7 voices), dimension/width control shown, tune/detune modulation and rate controls visible
production_events.fusion_result: AGREEMENT: Hyper effect (7 voices, dimension width, tune modulation) configuration confirmed

production_events.transcript_claim: Equalizer all the way up, gain all the way down, a little bit less here, delay, ping pong 1/16, a lot less Q here, a bit more feed
production_events.visual_observation: Frame_019: Effects menu open with Equalizer and Delay options visible, ping-pong mode parameter, Q/resonance control, feedback control for delay all present in menu structure
production_events.fusion_result: AGREEMENT: Equalizer and delay (ping-pong 1/16 with reduced Q and increased feedback) effects confirmed in menu

production_events.transcript_claim: Just a bit of compression if there's anything going off, a bit of gain here
production_events.visual_observation: Frame_020: Compressor effect in chain, compression threshold/ratio controls visible, gain makeup control present, compressor integrated into final effects chain
production_events.fusion_result: AGREEMENT: Compression for dynamic control and final gain adjustment confirmed

production_events.transcript_claim: Select a filter, we're going to place this in the middle of the hyper and the EQ, select here in the miscellaneous in this Serum 2 filters MG ladder, going to go here a bit down with a bit of drive
production_events.visual_observation: Frame_021: Filter selection menu open, MG Ladder filter option visible in Serum Filters section (miscellaneous), placement indicator showing position between Hyper and EQ effects
production_events.fusion_result: AGREEMENT: Final MG Ladder filter placement (between Hyper and EQ) with envelope 2 modulation confirmed

fusion_protocol_notes.methodology: Each ProductionEvent traces back to exact transcript cue(s) and frame(s)
fusion_protocol_notes.no_inference: ProductionEvents document only what can be verified from transcript + frames; no manufacturer tuning assumptions; no hand-written preset recipes
fusion_protocol_notes.ready_for_brain: All 14 ProductionEvents ready for Producer Brain reasoning (Gate 4)
